name: Youth Conservation Corps (Shenandoah National Park)
org: National Park Service, Shenandoah National Park
what_you_do: Work on a summer crew in a national park on conservation projects such as trails. The page does not list specific tasks.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 15 to 18 who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents. You must be able to commute to the work site every day. No housing is offered and no transportation is provided.
duration: About 8 weeks (2026 season June 15 to August 6)
deadline_text: 2026 last day to apply was April 24, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Download the YCC application form (DI-4014) from the park page and send it in. Questions go to nathaniel_phelps@nps.gov.
notes: The park is a drive from Charlottesville. Teens must arrange their own ride every day. Work permit rules for Virginia were not checked.
